rag_rationale: Reported 'GREEN-ish', but partner identity has slipped two months, delaying a dependent rollout, and the access-request SLA is being breached.
headline: SSO migration 79% done and on track; partner identity for Tallinn copilot agents slips to end of January.
progress: 142 of 180 applications migrated to the new identity provider
Access package design signed off; data platform packages due 30 Oct
Workload identity pattern documented with two adopters onboarded

risks.title: Partner identity federation incompatible
risks.description: The partner's identity provider cannot federate with the chosen standard until it upgrades in Q1 2027.
risks.mitigation: CISO to choose between partner upgrade, local guest accounts or a temporary IP-restricted exception.
risks.evidence: the partner's own identity provider is on an old version and doesn't support the federation standard we chose

risks.title: Identity team stretched, SLA breached
risks.description: Four people cover migration and BAU access requests; the request backlog is growing.
risks.evidence: avg wait for access request now 3.5 days, SLA is 2

risks.title: Legacy app upgrades unfunded
risks.description: About 8 legacy apps need vendor upgrades for modern auth; budget not approved.
risks.evidence: Budget for upgrades ~€90k not yet approved.

asks: CISO decision on the interim partner identity option
